name: Iwakura (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Iwakura city emblem in white: an outlined lozenge-shaped device enclosing an interlaced loop with two small rings.
history: Municipal flag of Iwakura, a city in Aichi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 25 December 1991; the emblem dates from 1 April 1959.

features.role: Iwakura city emblem — an outlined lozenge-shaped device enclosing an interlaced loop with two small rings
